Bouquet of flowers from allotment garden in Szczecin, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland. Cosmos bipinnatus , Tanacetum parthenium , Linaria purpurea , Cota tinctoria , Bidens ferulifolia , Calendula

Inflorescence Taxonym: Tanacetum parthenium ss Fischer et al. EfÖLS 2008 ISBN 978-3-85474-187-9 Location: Glasweiner Wald between Bergau and Füllersdorf, district Korneuburg, Lower Austria - ca. 360 m
Tanacetum parthenium is a flowering plant in the daisy family, Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine.
